main_text.p: XI. At quinam illi, quibus stata merces assignata? Archisynagogus, & Minister. De Ministro ibidem legi- tur, §. 23. שכר ש"צ פורעין מקופת הקהל Mercedem Ministro Synagoga solvunt ex erario cœtus, &c. De utro- que rursus ibidem, §. 24. & Iore Dea, Tit. CCLI. §. 13. ציבור שצריכין לשכור רב ושליח ציבור ואין בידם כדי שכר שניהם אם הוא רב מובהק וגדול בתורה ובקי בהוראה הוא קודם ואם לאו שליח ציבור קודם Si cœtus aliquis & Doctori (Archisynagogo) & Ministro mercedem persol- vere debeant, neque habeant unde illam utrique persol- vant; Archisynagogus præferendus est, siquidem vir celebris sit, egregieque in Lege & Iure versatus; sin vero, Mini- ster præferendus. Hic unius Rabbi, Archisynagogi men- tio fit, & Ministri, qui stipendia accipiant, nulla Se- niorum: quorum tamen non minus rationem habitam oportebat, siquidem illi etiam curæ suæ pretium cape- rent, quam Archisynagogi & Ministri.

XII. Priusquam autem hinc discedamus, locum modo ex Orach chaijim citatum, Tit. LIII. §. 26. vi- sum est reprehendere, & phrasin סתמן כפיכושן / quam supra Cap. I. §. 23. cum non satis assequeremur, in- tactam reliquimus, paulo distinctius explicare. Inge- nuitatis enim nostræ & prudentiæ esse videbatur, quod ipsi non satis caperemus, illius versione lectori non imponere: quare Judæum Magistrum consulere ma- luimus, quam audacem incertamque conjecturam pro- ferre. En igitur nunc solidam & elegantem illius ex- plicationem, quam Vir Clarissimus, David Pina Zor- phati, Med. Doct. patrii Juris callentissimus & diser- tissimus Orator, noster olim in Talmudicis præceptor, de ea per epistolam consultus, transmisit. שאלרת מסני

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek text is printed in Hebrew letters; the Hebrew lines are transcribed as printed, with some letters uncertain. The line ending "שאלרת" and "מסני" are doubtful. The reference mark "•" in the left margin beside "supra Cap. I." is a printer's mark, not a note. Watermark "Digitized by Google" omitted.
